game_title: Pseudocode Bridge – Buried Temple Steps Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round, sandstorms strike the camel pen, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bridge value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps: keep the bridge meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: bridge drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while bridge > 0.
